# IVNV

> IVNV is an eclectic DJ from Barcelona, Spain, focused on techno that ranges from raw and hypnotic to groovy and melodic.

This file gives AI assistants and agents a compact, factual summary of this site so answers about IVNV are accurate and attributable. Last updated: 2026-10-26.

## Identity

- Name: IVNV (artist / stage name)
- Role: DJ
- Home city: Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain
- Primary genre: techno
- Sub-styles: raw, hypnotic, deep and minimal, groovy, melodic
- Typical billing: club nights, underground parties and private events
- Official site: https://www.ivnvmusic.com/ (single page)

## Sound

- IVNV's sets oscillate between deep, minimalist rhythms and more intense, energetic sounds.
- His style is described as ranging from raw and hypnotic to groovy and melodic.
- He is influenced by the European techno scene and develops his sound through his sets and his work within Barcelona's local scene.
- Sets are built to feel cohesive, evolving and immersive, with a clear narrative from start to finish.

## Recorded sets: DARK & LOVELY

- DARK & LOVELY is IVNV's ongoing series of recorded sets, used to showcase the range of his sound.
- The series is published on SoundCloud: https://soundcloud.com/ivnv_music/sets/dark-lovely-episodes
